content: Ato Stephen siyasubun aurin on Saul ibasitai. Saul Ekalesia Yangan Baikokosar Ites On ra nan on ekalesia nan Jerusalem amonai simama on sibosuruf baikokosar komasin si’boai. Baitutumotis engon on siyames fetag fetag sitagege sinai Judea a Samaria tafanamai nan, baise baiyoyobotis on nan nana Jerusalem sima.
Sabu God sikwakwafirai yangan on Stephen sibo sinai sigarob ato fonas aumiet bag sitotou sibiyababan.
Baise Saul on ifofourtobon ekalesia yangan itikomasis mes; on fasinai on inai goa goa igeg, orot jever baitutumotis on iteteinis si’gat ato fafatum goai nan irereberues.
Wasagobin Samaria nan Sikurereb
Baitutumotis osi iyabon sitagege tafanam ta ta sinai, on nan dura sikurereb.
Philip on inai Samaria mafam gagamin nan Keriso aurin on nan sabu auris dura ikurereb.
Philip dura ibikakafun on, sabu kuayo on an dura on sitatam tiwag. osi engon on sitatamai, ato bobo buburis ifofour on sit.
Ayu Komasis on fonas aumiet bag sibiyoku weie sabu sigaraba tefasi emon sibikirires si’gat; sabu ass imas raguraguis mat on engon siyawas.
On mes Samaria mafam gagamin amonai on yaisisir gagamin bag imatar.
On mafam gagamin amonai on orot wabin Simon on nan imama, on orot on nan Samaria imama ifafarum on sabu engon tutufin sibiduduran. On toun iyoyorai on orot gagamin bag,

ato sabu engon tutufin nan mafam gagaminai simama, sabu gugudis sabu gagamis on engon on orot fonan wat sitatamai. Sabu si’yau, “On orot on God an faiwar ibo, on faiwar wabin seyoyorai, ‘Faiwar Gagamin.’”
On wera weromin maiau osi sabu auris on ifafarum, ato sabu on an dura wat on sitatam tiwag.
Baise osi Philip an dura ato God an Baiaiwab an Wasagobin a Iesu Keriso Wabin aurin ikurereb si’tatam on situtum, ato orot jever engon sibapataito.
Simon toun mat on itutum; ato gibui ibapataito, on Philip bisinai ima, ato on iduduran kwakwan ato bobo baiduduranis a bobo buburis ifofour on.
Baiyoyobotis nan Jerusalem simama on dura sitatam, Samaria yangan on God an dura sibo; on mes osi Peter a John rus nan siyafares sinai.
Osi sinai sigat mom, ato osi simisir baitutumotis auris sibayoi Ayu Kakafotin sitboai mes.
Yabin Ayu Kakafotin on men isur orot jever tani aurin on; baise osi asir Bada Iesu Wabinai sibapataito mom.
Namon Peter a John rus on imas sabu tefasi siyagagaien ato Ayu Kakafotin sibo.
Simon on bobo it, ato baiyoyobotis on imas sabu tefasi siyagagaien ato Ayu si’boai. On mes Simon agim ikutetai Peter a John rus auris,
ato iyau, “Atonio faiwar on yau mat woiteu, ato yau imau orot jever tefanai anyayagai on Ayu Kakafotin inboboai.”
Baise Peter iyafotai iyau, “Om a am agim mat on wotarab itsawar, yabin om enonosin God an siwar on agimai untobon mom!
Om men wei ai bobo turin amonai unabo on, yabin om nunuam on men obin God matanai.
Om am bainonot komasin emon on ya baikitabir unboai ato Bada aurin unbayoi ato am bainonot komasis emon on innotburem.
Yau om aitem on, om nunuam on er dorem a baiboboar auman, ato om am bokomas emon on ifatumem.”
Simon on Peter a John rus auris iyau, “Arie, omi Bada aurin wonbayoi weineu ato dura ato ubikakafun on men auriu inmatar mes.”

Peter a John rus on Iesu sisasagobai an dudur a Bada an dura on sikasones isawar gibunai, osi simatabir men sinai au Jerusalem. Osi si’nan eta nenenai mafam gugudis sigaraba Samaria tafanam amonai sen on nan auris Wasagobin sikurereb.
Philip a Ethiopia an Orot Gagamin
Bada an anea on Philip aurin ikakafun iyau, “Om ebotitiwagim ato unan eta ato Jerusalem inai Gaza mafam gagaminai i’gat on nan ungat.” (Atonio eta on ari men nan sebibib on.)

On mes Philip ibotitiwagai ato inai. On etaiai on Ethiopia orot ato yasfun fofous siboseseiren, on etai ibib i’nat au go. Atonio orot on orot gagamin, ato on Ethiopia an aiwab jever an agim goa on ikakaifarai a on jever min on an baibad wabin seyoyorai, “Candace.” On orot on inat Jerusalem nan God ikwakwafirai on imatabir men an motob wa wabin carriage on tefanai i’nat. On orot on motob an wa tefanai imair iyayai i’nat ato aubairuruotin Isaiah an buk on ibiyab.
Ayu Kakafotin on Philip iyawur iyau, “Om enai ato motob an wa wabin carriage, on bisinai ebib unnanan.”
Philip iyayai irabon ato on itatam, orot on aubairuruotin Isaiah an buk on ibiyab; on mes Philip on orot itetemai iyau, “Om min usagob abifan ebiyab i?”
Orot gagamin iyafotai iyau, “Orot tani auriu inau bubunag, on arimon an sagob.” Ato orot on Philip iyawur igai wa carriage tefanai ato bisinai imair.
On buk amonai dura ibiyab min atonio:

content.text: “On foro sheep ba sibo sinai siyasubun; On foro sheep kafakakai ba usin bubunin siyasutin on men iwaf mes; On men abi dura tani iyau on.
On simamaiai, ato men eta totorinai sigurubabanai on. On wawan agirin auris on, men iyafan tani inkasonet tantatam, yabin On an yawas tafanamai on inat au kanfoun isawar.”

content: Orot gagamin Philip aurin iyau, “Om ekasoneu, aubairuruotin min iyafan aurin ebikakafun? On toun aurin ebikakafun o orot tani aurin ebikakafun?”
Philip ibosuruf dura ikakafun; atonio dura buk amonai sigagayam on, anai bag ibosuruf, ato Iesu an Wasagobin aurin on iyawur.
Osi etai siyayai sisusur ato sinat sareu i’yen on nan sigat, ato orot gagamin iyau, “Sareu atonio. Ato bobo aifan on arimon inyafoteu men anibapataito i?”
(Philip on orot aurin iyau, “Om nunuam tutufinai unbitutum on arimon unibapataito.” On iyafotai iyau, “Yau abitutum, yau abitutum Iesu Keriso on God Natun.”)
Orot gagamin on ato motob wa i’yai on ibotan; Philip a orot gagamin, osi rus sisur sareuai nan, ato Philip imisir on ibapataitoai.
Osi sareu emon sigai mom, Ayu Kakafotin on Philip ibo siwanai. Orot gagamin on men Philip magin it men, baise on iyasisir kwakwan nana etai iyayai inai.
Philip on Ashdod mafam gagaminai nan irobotet; ato on inai mafam gagamis engon amosi nan Wasagobin ikurereb mom, inai Caesarea mafam gagaminai nan igat.
